channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Kurtulmuş, DEM Party discuss next steps after key panel report
item.description: Parliament Speaker Numan Kurtulmuş continued his tour of political leaders following the delivery of a final report by a commission overseeing the government’s “terror-free Türkiye” initiative, meeting this time with officials from the Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party).

item.title: Türkiye’s doctor visits top 1 bln as strain mounts on public health system
item.description: Türkiye logged over 1 billion doctor visits and 116.6 million medical imaging procedures in 2024, the Health Ministry’s data has shown, illustrating the enormous demand on the national health care system and the leading position of public providers.

item.title: Toprak Razgatlıoğlu set for MotoGP debut
item.description: Toprak Razgatlıoğlu, the Turkish standout who has dominated World Superbike racing, is set to make his highly anticipated MotoGP debut this weekend at the Thailand Grand Prix.

item.title: Türkiye braces for severe rain, storms amid plunging temperatures
item.description: Heavy downpours, fresh snowfall and gusty winds are set to sweep across much of the country in the coming days, with temperatures set to dip by 4 to 6 degrees Celsius in the western and central provinces, the Turkish State Meteorological Service has warned.

item.title: Türkiye promotes rooftop solar at homes to expand sustainable energy use
item.description: Türkiye is promoting rooftop solar systems as part of efforts to expand decentralized renewable energy use and widen public participation in the energy transition.

item.title: Germany's Merz tells Xi of 'great opportunity' to develop ties
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz touched down in China on Wednesday, beginning his inaugural visit to his country's largest trade partner and a high-tech rival as Europe's biggest economy struggles.

item.title: Energy Minister Bayraktar holds talks in South Korea
item.description: Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar traveled to Seoul for the ninth Türkiye–South Korea Joint Economic Commission (KEK) meeting, where he held high-level talks on expanding bilateral energy cooperation.

item.title: Iranians worry over US military buildup amid last-chance talks
item.description: As the United States assembles its greatest military firepower in decades in the Middle East, Iranians are warily awaiting the next round of talks with the U.S. in Geneva today — negotiations that many see as a last chance for their ruling theocracy to strike a deal with U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: Turkish F-16 jet crash in country's west kills pilot
item.description: A Turkish Air Force F‑16 fighter jet crashed near a highway in western Türkiye early on Feb. 25, killing its pilot, officials and media reports have said.

item.title: Erdoğan hits out at critics over Ramadan activities
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan on Wednesday accused certain secular circles of targeting religious expression during Ramadan, saying reforms expanding freedom of belief continued to unsettle parts of the opposition.
